title: "gpp"
author: "Gabriella Dauber"
date: "1/31/2025"
model: "Assimilation Capacity Coordinates with Light Interception, Mean Assimilation and Transpiration Efficiency (ACCLIMATE), developed by Kevin Tu"
timestep: "Daily"
output: html_document
---

```{r acclim}


# Checks
# 1 - Check to make sure that the input data looks reasonable. For example, the PAR data looks too high for some years so using SWR instead looks more robust.

#Inputs: Latitude, Year, JD, DayNum (count), Tnight (deg C), Tdaily (deg C), SWRdaily (W/m2), NDVI, EVI2, VPDdaily (kPa), ca_daily (umol/mol), Pdaily (Pa), Rndaily (W/m2), LEdaily (W/m2)
#Observations: Daily GPP (gC/m2d; average rate over 24-hrs)

#Constants: 
tc = 7 # time constant for acclimation (days)
GPPmean2GPPmax = 0.6 # ratio of mean GPP to the maximum GPP asymptote (dimensionless)
Oi = 20900 # leaf internal oxygen partial pressure (Pa)
QRC3 = 12 # quantum requirement for C3 plants (mol photons / mol CO2)
QRC4 = 16.67 # quantum requirement for C4 plants (mol photons / mol CO2)
EVI2min = 0.15 # minimum EVI of bare ground (dimensionless)
EVI2max = 0.80 # maximum EVI of a full green canopy (dimensionless)
fresp = 0.1 # leaf respiration as a fraction of gross photosynthetic capacity (dimensionless)

# Import FLUXNET dataset
library(readr)
data <- read_csv("GPP_Project/FLX_US-Ha1_FLUXNET2015_FULLSET_DD_1991-2012_1-4.csv")

##Calculations

# Initialize all necessary columns with NA
data$dl <- NA
data$Tmin <- NA
data$Tmax <- NA
data$Tday <- NA
data$ea <- NA
data$esTmin <- NA
data$esTmax <- NA
data$esTday <- NA
data$VPDmax <- NA
data$VPDday <- NA
data$PARday <- NA
data$dt <- NA
data$w <- NA
data$Pmean <- NA
data$ca_mean <- NA
data$Tday_mean <- NA
data$Tmax_mean <- NA
data$esTmax_mean <- NA
data$VPDday_mean <- NA
data$VPDmax_mean <- NA
data$PARday_mean <- NA
data$fcold_mean <- NA
data$tau_mean <- NA
data$gamma_star_mean <- NA
data$cicaC3_mean <- NA
data$cicaC4_mean <- NA
data$piC3_mean <- NA
data$piC4_mean <- NA
data$QYC3_mean <- NA
data$QYC4_mean <- NA
data$FAPAR <- NA
data$GPPmax_C3 <- NA
data$GPPmax_C4 <- NA
data$GPPday_mean_C3 <- NA
data$GPPday_mean_C4 <- NA
data$C4frac <- NA
data$PredGPPmean <- NA
data$EddyGPPday <- NA
data$EddyGPPday_mean <- NA
data$Rnday <- NA
data$Rnday_mean <- NA
data$s_mean <- NA
data$s_ratio_mean <- NA
data$PT_mean <- NA
data$RHmin <- NA
data$RHmin_mean <- NA
data$fwet_mean <- NA
data$fSM_mean <- NA
data$PredLEiday_mean <- NA
data$PredLEsday_mean <- NA
data$PredLEcday_mean <- NA
data$PredLEday_mean <- NA
data$EddyLEday_mean <- NA

# Assign latitude column
data$Latitude <- 42.5378	

# Renaming input columns for FLUXNET2015 data
names(data)[which(names(data) == "TA_F_NIGHT")] <- "Tnight"   # Nighttime air temperature
names(data)[which(names(data) == "TA_F")] <- "Tdaily"         # Daily air temperature
names(data)[which(names(data) == "VPD_F")] <- "VPDdaily"      # Daily vapor pressure deficit
names(data)[which(names(data) == "PPFD_IN")] <- "PARdaily"    # Daily photosynthetic active radiation
names(data)[which(names(data) == "GPP_F_MDS")] <- "GPPdaily"  # Daily gross primary productivity
names(data)[which(names(data) == "SW_IN_F")] <- "SWRdaily"    # Daily shortwave radiation
names(data)[which(names(data) == "PA_F")] <- "Pdaily"         # Daily air pressure
names(data)[which(names(data) == "CO2_F_MDS")] <- "ca_daily"  # Daily CO2 concentration
names(data)[which(names(data) == "NETRAD")] <- "Rndaily"      # Daily net radiation
names(data)[which(names(data) == "LE_F_MDS")] <- "LEdaily"    # Daily latent energy flux
                    
# Daily precipitation accumulation (mm); never substitute zero for missing rain.
if (!'P_F' %in% names(data)) stop('FLUXNET P_F precipitation is required (mm/day).')
data$precip <- data$P_F
data$precip[data$precip < 0] <- NA_real_
data$period_days <- 1

# Ensure unit consistency 
# FLUXNET2015 missing-value sentinel; retain missing values explicitly.
data[] <- lapply(data, function(v) { if (is.numeric(v)) v[v == -9999] <- NA_real_; v })
data$VPDdaily <- data$VPDdaily / 10 # Convert hPa to kPa
data$Pdaily <- data$Pdaily * 1000 # FLUXNET PA_F is kPa; model uses Pa

# Extract Year and Julian Day (JD) from TIMESTAMP
data$Year <- as.integer(substr(data$TIMESTAMP, 1, 4))
data$JD <- as.integer(format(as.Date(as.character(data$TIMESTAMP), "%Y%m%d"), "%j"))

data$date <- as.Date(as.character(data$TIMESTAMP), '%Y%m%d')
if (anyNA(data$date) || anyDuplicated(data$date) || is.unsorted(data$date))
  stop('Input dates must be valid, unique, and increasing.')
# Precompute instantaneous inputs before initializing running means from rows 1:5.
# NDVI/EVI2 must already be joined to this FLUXNET table by the input workflow.
required_forcing <- c('Tnight', 'Tdaily', 'SWRdaily', 'Rndaily', 'Pdaily', 'ca_daily', 'EVI2')
if (!all(required_forcing %in% names(data))) stop('Missing meteorology or joined EVI2 forcing.')
if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(data[required_forcing]))))
  stop('Fill or resolve missing model forcings before running ACCLIM; do not bridge bucket gaps.')
solar_delta <- 0.4093 * sin(2*pi*(data$JD - 81)/365)
data$dl <- pmax(0.5, pmin(23.5, 24/pi * acos(pmax(-1, pmin(1,
  -tan(data$Latitude*pi/180) * tan(solar_delta))))))
data$Tmin <- 2*data$Tnight - data$Tdaily
data$Tmax <- 2*data$Tdaily - data$Tmin
data$Tday <- (data$Tmax + data$Tdaily)/2
data$esTmin <- 0.61121*exp(17.502*data$Tmin/(data$Tmin+240.97))
data$esTmax <- 0.61121*exp(17.502*data$Tmax/(data$Tmax+240.97))
data$VPDmax <- data$esTmax-data$esTmin
data$esTday <- 0.61121*exp(17.502*data$Tday/(data$Tday+240.97))
data$VPDday <- data$esTday-data$esTmin
data$PARday <- 2.2*data$SWRdaily*24/data$dl
data$Rnday <- data$Rndaily*24/data$dl
data$RHmin <- pmin(1, pmax(0, data$esTmin/data$esTmax))
initial_rows <- seq_len(min(5, nrow(data)))

# View data
View(data)
colnames(data)

# Loop for calculating
for (i in 1:(nrow(data))) {


# Daylength, dl (hours)
	# dl was precomputed from latitude and day of year above.

# Minimum daily air temperature, Tmin (deg C)
	data$Tmin[i] <- 2 * data$Tnight[i] - data$Tdaily[i]

# Maximum daily air temperature, Tmax (deg C)
	data$Tmax[i] <- 2 * data$Tdaily[i] - data$Tmin[i]

# Mean daytime temperature, Tday (degC)
	data$Tday[i] <- (data$Tmax[i] + 0.5 * (data$Tmax[i] + data$Tmin[i])) / 2 

# Daily water vapor pressure, ea (kPa)
	# data$ea[i] <- (0.61121 * exp(17.502 * data$Tdaily[i] / (data$Tdaily[i] + 240.97))) - data$VPDdaily[i] # use when ea is available
	data$esTmin[i] <- 0.61121 * exp(17.502 * data$Tmin[i] / (data$Tmin[i] + 240.97)) # use when ea is not available

# Daily maximum saturation water vapor pressure, esTmax (kPa)
	data$esTmax[i] <- 0.61121 * exp(17.502 * data$Tmax[i] / (data$Tmax[i] + 240.97))

# Daytime saturation water vapor pressure, esTday (kPa)
	data$esTday[i] <- 0.61121 * exp(17.502 * data$Tday[i] / (data$Tday[i] + 240.97))

# Maximum daily saturation water vapor pressure deficit, VPDmax (kPa)
	# data$VPDmax[i] <- (data$esTmax[i]) - (data$ea[i]) # use when ea is available
	data$VPDmax[i] <- (data$esTmax[i]) - (data$esTmin[i]) # use when ea is not available

# Daytime saturation water vapor pressure deficit, VPDday (kPa)
	# data$VPDday[i] <- (data$esTday[i]) - (data$ea[i]) # use when ea is available
	data$VPDday[i] <- (data$esTday[i]) - (data$esTmin[i]) # use when ea is not available

# Daytime photosynthetically active radiation, PARday (umol/m2s)
	data$PARday[i] <- (2.2 * data$SWRdaily[i]) * (24 / data$dl[i])

# Time difference between current and previous valid data, dt (days)
	if (i == 1) {data$dt[i] <- 1} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$dt[i] <- data$dt[i-1]} 
		else {data$dt[i] <- as.numeric(data$date[i] - data$date[i-1])}}

# Weighting coefficient for running mean calculations, w (-)
	data$w[i] <- exp(-data$dt[i] / tc)

# Running mean of daytime air pressure, Pmean (Pa)
	if (i == 1) {data$Pmean[i] <- mean(data$Pdaily[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$Pmean[i] <- data$Pmean[i-1]} 
		else {data$Pmean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$Pmean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$Pdaily[i]}}

# Running mean of daily CO2 concentration, ca_mean (umol CO2/mol air)
	if (i == 1) {data$ca_mean[i] <- mean(data$ca_daily[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$ca_mean[i] <- data$ca_mean[i-1]} 
		else {data$ca_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$ca_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$ca_daily[i]}}	  
	  
# Running mean of daytime air temperature, Tday_mean (deg C)
	if (i == 1) {data$Tday_mean[i] <- mean(data$Tday[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$Tday_mean[i] <- data$Tday_mean[i-1]} 
		else {data$Tday_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$Tday_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$Tday[i]}}
	  
# Running mean of maximum daily air temperature, Tmax_mean (deg C)
	if (i == 1) {data$Tmax_mean[i] <- mean(data$Tmax[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$Tmax_mean[i] <- data$Tmax_mean[i-1]} 
		else {data$Tmax_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$Tmax_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$Tmax[i]}}

# Running mean of daytime VPD, VPDday_mean (kPa)
	if (i == 1) {data$VPDday_mean[i] <- mean(data$VPDday[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$VPDday_mean[i] <- data$VPDday_mean[i-1]}
		else {data$VPDday_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$VPDday_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$VPDday[i]}}

# Running mean of daily maximum VPD, VPDmax_mean (kPa)
	if (i == 1) {data$VPDmax_mean[i] <- mean(data$VPDmax[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$VPDmax_mean[i] <- data$VPDmax_mean[i-1]}
		else {data$VPDmax_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$VPDmax_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$VPDmax[i]}}

# Running mean daytime PAR, PARday_mean (umol/m2s)
	if (i == 1) {data$PARday_mean[i] <- mean(data$PARday[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$PARday_mean[i] <- data$PARday_mean[i - 1]}
		else {data$PARday_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$PARday_mean[i - 1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$PARday[i]}}

# Cold temperature constraint when PAR is absorbed but not used for photosynthesis, fcold_mean (dimensionless)
	data$fcold_mean[i] <- 1 / ( 1 + exp(0.3 * (5 - data$Tday_mean[i])) )

# CO2/O2 specificity of Rubisco, tau_mean (dimensionless)
	data$tau_mean[i] <- 2600 * 0.57^( (data$Tday_mean[i] - 25) / 10 )

# Photocompensation point, chloroplast CO2 concentration at which photosynthesis equals photorespiration, gamma_star_mean (Pa) 
	data$gamma_star_mean[i] <- Oi / ( 2 * data$tau_mean[i] )

# Daytime net radiation, Rnday (W/m2)
	data$Rnday[i] <- data$Rndaily[i] * (24 / data$dl[i])

# Running mean of daytime Rn, Rnday_mean (W/m2)
	if (i == 1) {data$Rnday_mean[i] <- mean(data$Rnday[initial_rows])} 
	else {if (data$Rnday[i] < 10) {data$Rnday_mean[i] <- data$Rnday_mean[i - 1]}
		else {data$Rnday_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$Rnday_mean[i - 1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$Rnday[i]}}

# Running mean saturation vapor pressure (required for s_mean).
  if (i == 1) { data$esTmax_mean[i] <- mean(data$esTmax[initial_rows]) }
  else if (data$PARday[i] < 10) { data$esTmax_mean[i] <- data$esTmax_mean[i-1] }
  else { data$esTmax_mean[i] <- data$w[i]*data$esTmax_mean[i-1] + (1-data$w[i])*data$esTmax[i] }

# Mean slope of the saturation vapor pressure-temperature curve, s_mean
	data$s_mean[i] <- 17.502 * 240.97 * data$esTmax_mean[i] / ((data$Tmax_mean[i] + 240.97)^2)

# Mean C3 ratio of leaf internal (ci) to atmospheric (ca) CO2 concentration, cicaC3_mean (dimensionless)
	data$zC3[i] = ((1.5*GPPmean2GPPmax*2500*18)/(QRC3*1.26*(1+fresp)))*((data$s_mean[i]+0.066)*data$VPDday_mean[i]*data$PARday_mean[i]*1000)/(data$s_mean[i]*data$Rnday_mean[i]*data$Pmean[i])
  # Quadratic solves ci in ppm; convert Gamma* from Pa and divide ci by ca.
  gamma_ppm <- data$gamma_star_mean[i] * 1e6 / data$Pmean[i]
  data$bC3[i] <- 2*gamma_ppm + data$zC3[i] - data$ca_mean[i]
  data$cC3[i] <- -gamma_ppm * (data$zC3[i] + 2*data$ca_mean[i])
  data$cicaC3_mean[i] <- (-data$bC3[i] + sqrt(max(0, data$bC3[i]^2 - 4*data$cC3[i]))) / (2*data$ca_mean[i])
	
# Mean C4 ratio of leaf internal (ci) to atmospheric (ca) CO2 concentration, cicaC4_mean (dimensionless)
	data$cicaC4_mean[i] <- 0.4 

# Mean leaf internal CO2 partial pressure, pi_mean (Pa)
	data$piC3_mean[i] <- data$cicaC3_mean[i] * data$ca_mean[i] * ( data$Pmean[i] / 1000000 )
	data$piC4_mean[i] <- data$cicaC4_mean[i] * data$ca_mean[i] * ( data$Pmean[i] / 1000000 )

# Mean quantum yield, QYC3_mean (mol CO2/mol photons)
	data$QYC3_mean[i] <- data$fcold_mean[i] * (1/QRC3) * ( data$piC3_mean[i] - data$gamma_star_mean[i] ) / ( data$piC3_mean[i] + 2 * data$gamma_star_mean[i] )
	data$QYC4_mean[i] <- data$fcold_mean[i] * (1/QRC4) 
	
# Deferred FAPAR calibration idea (2026-09-16; documentation only).
# Fit paired, quality-screened observations: NDVI^2 = a + b * EVI2 (b > 0).
# Derive effective endpoints EVI2min = -a/b and EVI2max = (1-a)/b, then
# use FAPAR = clamp((EVI2-EVI2min)/(EVI2max-EVI2min), 0, 1).
# Intent: anchor the scale to NDVI^2 while retaining EVI2 temporal variation
# and its potential sensitivity to green foliage amid non-green material.
# These are calibration endpoints, not necessarily observed soil/full-canopy values.
# If revisited, fit fixed endpoints across multiple years with balanced VI coverage;
# check slope/endpoints and validate on withheld years against independent data.
# Fitting to NDVI^2 can inherit its saturation/bias; improvement is not guaranteed.
# Do not implement yet: the observed performance gain is small and added calibration
# may introduce bugs. Revisit later; retain the current executable FAPAR calculation.
# FAPAR (dimensionless), fraction of incident PAR absorbed by chlorophyll or the green photosynthetically active leaf area
	data$FAPAR[i] <- max(0, min(1, (data$EVI2[i] - EVI2min) / ( EVI2max - EVI2min) )) 

# Maximum gross photosynthesis asymptote, GPPmax (umolCO2/m2s)
	data$GPPmax_C3[i] = data$QYC3_mean[i] * ( data$FAPAR[i] * data$PARday_mean[i] )
	data$GPPmax_C4[i] = data$QYC4_mean[i] * ( data$FAPAR[i] * data$PARday_mean[i] )

# Mean daytime gross primary productivity, GPPday_mean (umolsCO2/m2s)
	data$GPPday_mean_C3[i] = GPPmean2GPPmax * data$GPPmax_C3[i] 
	data$GPPday_mean_C4[i] = GPPmean2GPPmax * data$GPPmax_C4[i] 

# Mean C4frac (dimensionless), fraction of ground area covered by C4 plants (dimensionless)	
	data$C4frac[i] = 1 / (1 + exp(-4.04 *(data$GPPmax_C4[i]/data$GPPmax_C3[i]) + 5.99))  

# Mean predicted daytime GPP, PredGPPday_mean (unolCO2/m2s)
	data$PredGPPmean[i] = (1 - data$C4frac[i]) * data$GPPday_mean_C3[i] + (data$C4frac[i]) * data$GPPday_mean_C4[i]

# Daytime eddy covariance GPP, EddyGPPday (umolCO2/m2s)
	data$EddyGPPday[i] <- data$GPPdaily[i] * (1000000 / 12) / (data$dl[i] * 60 * 60)

# Mean daytime eddy covariance GPP over the last tc days, EddyGPPday_mean (umolCO2/m2s)
	if (i < tc) {data$EddyGPPday_mean[i] <- NA}
	else {data$EddyGPPday_mean[i] <- mean(data$EddyGPPday[(i-tc):i], na.rm = TRUE)}




# Additional equations for transpiration, soil evaporation and interception evaporation

# Mimimum daily relative humidity, RHmin (fraction) 
	data$RHmin[i] <- min(1, max(0, data$esTmin[i] / data$esTmax[i]))
	
# Running mean of minimum relative humidity, RHmin_mean (%)
	if (i == 1) {data$RHmin_mean[i] <- mean(data$RHmin[initial_rows])}
	else {if (data$PARday[i] < 10) {data$RHmin_mean[i] <- data$RHmin_mean[i-1]}
		else {data$RHmin_mean[i] <- data$w[i] * data$RHmin_mean[i-1] + (1 - data$w[i]) * data$RHmin[i]}}

# Mean Ratio s/(s+y), s_ratio_mean (dimensionless)
	data$s_ratio_mean[i] <- data$s_mean[i] / (data$s_mean[i] + 0.066)
	
# Mean relative surface wetness, fwet_mean (dimensionless)
	data$fwet_mean[i] <- data$RHmin_mean[i]^10

# Mean Priestley-Taylor, PT_mean (W/m^2)
	data$PT_mean[i] <- 1.26 * data$s_ratio_mean[i] * data$Rnday_mean[i]
  
# Mean predicted daytime transpiration, PredLEcday_mean, modeled as PT applied to green leaves
	data$PredLEcday_mean[i] <- data$PT_mean[i] * data$FAPAR[i] * data$fcold_mean[i] * (1 - data$fwet_mean[i])

# Mean soil moisture constraint, fSM_mean (dimensionless)
	data$fSM_mean[i] <- data$RHmin_mean[i]^data$VPDmax_mean[i]

# Mean predicted daytime interception evaporation, PredLEiday_mean (W/m2)
	data$PredLEiday_mean[i] <- data$fwet_mean[i] * data$PT_mean[i] * data$FAPAR[i]

# Mean predicted daytime soil evaporation, PredLEsday_mean (W/m2)
	data$PredLEsday_mean[i] <- (data$fwet_mean[i] + (1 - data$fwet_mean[i]) * data$fSM_mean[i]) * data$PT_mean[i] * (1 - data$FAPAR[i])

# Mean predicted daytime latent energy flux, PredLEday_mean (W/m2)
	data$PredLEday_mean[i] = data$PredLEcday_mean[i] + data$PredLEsday_mean[i] + data$PredLEiday_mean[i]

# Daytime eddy covariance LE, EddyLEday (W/m2)
	data$EddyLEday[i] <- data$LEdaily[i] * (24 / data$dl[i])

# Mean observed daytime latent energy flux, EddyLEday_mean (W/m2)
	if (i < tc) {data$EddyLEday_mean[i] <- NA}
	else {data$EddyLEday_mean[i] <- mean(data$EddyLEday[(i-tc):i], na.rm = TRUE)}
	


}


# Retrospective effective evaporative storage calibration; inputs are totals in mm
# for each row's period. The daily FLUXNET driver uses P_F (mm/day accumulated).
# A monthly driver should pass TerraClimate pr totals and calendar-month lengths.
# Surface/litter evaporation is external to the bucket; all precipitation enters
# the bucket. This is an empirical moisture index, not a closed whole-system
# water balance or a retrieval of volumetric moisture at a known soil depth.
soil_bucket_period <- function(sm, capacity, precip, potential_mm) {
  # Exact integration over normalized period u in [0,1]:
  # dSM/du = precip - (potential_mm/capacity)*SM, capped at capacity.
  # Uniform within-period precipitation is an assumption, not observed storm timing.
  q <- potential_mm / capacity
  surplus <- precip - potential_mm
  t <- 1
  if (surplus > 0) {
    gap_over_surplus <- max(0, capacity-sm) / surplus
    x <- q * gap_over_surplus
    log_ratio <- if (x < 1e-5) 1-x/2+x^2/3 else log1p(x)/x
    t <- min(1, gap_over_surplus * log_ratio)
  }
  z <- q*t
  phi <- if (z < 1e-4) 1-z/2+z^2/6-z^3/24 else -expm1(-z)/z
  psi <- if (z < 1e-4) 0.5-z/6+z^2/24-z^3/120 else (1-phi)/z
  mean_sm <- max(0, min(capacity, sm*t*phi + precip*t^2*psi + capacity*(1-t)))
  fraction <- mean_sm / capacity
  evaporation <- potential_mm * fraction
  overflow <- max(0, surplus)*(1-t)
  end_sm <- max(0, min(capacity, sm+precip-evaporation-overflow))
  list(mean_sm=mean_sm, fraction=fraction, evaporation=evaporation, overflow=overflow, end_sm=end_sm)
}

soil_bucket_trajectory <- function(x, capacity) {
  stopifnot(is.finite(capacity), capacity > 0)
  sm <- capacity # full initial bucket, no spin-up
  out <- x
  out$fSM_RHVPD <- x$fSM_mean
  out$PredLEsday_RHVPD <- x$PredLEsday_mean
  out$PredLEday_RHVPD <- x$PredLEday_mean
  out$SMmax <- capacity
  sse <- weight <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    conversion <- x$dl[i] * 3600 * x$period_days[i] / 2450000
    potential <- x$PT_mean[i] * (1 - x$FAPAR[i])
    surface_le <- x$fwet_mean[i] * potential
    potential_mm <- (1-x$fwet_mean[i]) * max(0, potential) * conversion
    period <- soil_bucket_period(sm, capacity, x$precip[i], potential_mm)
    fraction <- period$fraction
    soil_mm <- period$evaporation
    soil_le <- soil_mm / conversion
    total_le <- surface_le + soil_le
    out$SM[i] <- sm
    out$SM_mean[i] <- period$mean_sm
    out$SM_end[i] <- period$end_sm
    out$fSM_start[i] <- sm/capacity
    out$fSM_mean[i] <- fraction
    out$PredLEs_surface_mean[i] <- surface_le
    out$PredLEs_soil_mean[i] <- soil_le
    out$Esoil_period[i] <- soil_mm
    out$Esurface_period[i] <- surface_le * conversion
    out$bucket_overflow[i] <- period$overflow
    out$bucket_water_limited[i] <- potential_mm > 0 && fraction < 1
    out$PredLEsday_mean[i] <- total_le
    out$PredLEday_mean[i] <- x$PredLEcday_mean[i] + x$PredLEiday_mean[i] + total_le
    w <- if (potential > 0) x$period_days[i] else 0
    sse <- sse + (total_le - x$PredLEsday_mean[i])^2 * w
    weight <- weight + w
    sm <- out$SM_end[i]
  }
  out$SM_integration <- 'analytic period mean; uniform precipitation within period'
  list(data = out, mse = sse / max(1, weight), weight = weight)
}

fit_soil_bucket <- function(x, initial = 100, minimum = 1, maximum = 2000, grid_size = 25) {
  stopifnot(minimum > 0, maximum > minimum, initial >= minimum,
            initial <= maximum, grid_size >= 3, grid_size == as.integer(grid_size))
  required <- c('precip', 'period_days', 'dl', 'fwet_mean', 'PT_mean', 'FAPAR',
                'fSM_mean', 'PredLEsday_mean', 'PredLEday_mean',
                'PredLEcday_mean', 'PredLEiday_mean', 'date')
  if (!all(required %in% names(x))) stop('Missing bucket input columns.')
  x$fSM_RHVPD <- x$fSM_mean
  x$PredLEsday_RHVPD <- x$PredLEsday_mean
  x$PredLEday_RHVPD <- x$PredLEday_mean
  x$SM_fit_RMSE <- NA_real_
  x$SM_initial_guess <- initial
  x$SM_search_min <- minimum
  x$SM_search_max <- maximum
  x$SM_initialization <- 'full; no spin-up'
  x$SM_units <- 'mm effective evaporative storage'
  x$precip_units <- 'mm/period'
  numeric_inputs <- setdiff(required, 'date')
  valid <- nrow(x) > 0 && all(vapply(x[numeric_inputs], function(v) all(is.finite(v)), logical(1))) &&
    !anyNA(x$date) && all(x$precip >= 0) && all(x$period_days > 0) &&
    all(x$dl > 0 & x$dl <= 24) && all(x$fwet_mean >= 0 & x$fwet_mean <= 1) &&
    all(x$FAPAR >= 0 & x$FAPAR <= 1) && all(x$fSM_mean >= 0 & x$fSM_mean <= 1)
  contiguous <- valid && (nrow(x) == 1 ||
    all(as.numeric(diff(x$date)) == head(x$period_days, -1)))
  if (!contiguous || sum(x$period_days) < 365) {
    x$SM_fit_status <- 'baseline_requires_complete_contiguous_year'
    warning('Bucket not fitted: requires at least a complete contiguous year of valid inputs; retaining RH/VPD.')
    return(x)
  }
  potential <- x$PT_mean * (1-x$FAPAR)
  full_soil <- (1-x$fwet_mean) * pmax(0,potential)
  full_loss <- full_soil * x$dl * 3600 * x$period_days / 2450000
  if (all(x$precip >= full_loss)) {
    # All candidates start and remain full; capacity itself is unidentified.
    x$fSM_mean <- 1
    x$fSM_start <- 1
    x$PredLEsday_mean <- x$fwet_mean*potential + full_soil
    x$PredLEday_mean <- x$PredLEcday_mean + x$PredLEiday_mean + x$PredLEsday_mean
    x$SM_fit_status <- 'unconstrained_full_bucket'
    return(x)
  }
  score <- function(cap) soil_bucket_trajectory(x, cap)$mse
  step <- (log(maximum) - log(minimum)) / (grid_size - 1)
  candidates <- c(initial, exp(seq(log(minimum), log(maximum), length.out = grid_size)))
  errors <- vapply(candidates, score, numeric(1))
  best <- candidates[which.min(errors)]
  best_error <- min(errors)
  spread <- max(errors[-1]) - min(errors[-1])
  for (pass in 1:3) {
    trial <- exp(pmax(log(minimum), pmin(log(maximum), log(best) + (-4:4) * step / 4)))
    trial_errors <- vapply(trial, score, numeric(1))
    j <- which.min(trial_errors)
    if (trial_errors[j] < best_error) { best <- trial[j]; best_error <- trial_errors[j] }
    step <- step / 4
  }
  fitted <- soil_bucket_trajectory(x, best)
  if (spread <= 1e-8 || fitted$weight == 0) {
    x$SM_fit_status <- 'baseline_unidentifiable_capacity'
    warning('Bucket capacity is unidentifiable; retaining RH/VPD.')
    return(x)
  }
  out <- fitted$data
  out$SM_fit_RMSE <- sqrt(best_error)
  out$SM_fit_status <- if (best <= minimum * 1.001 || best >= maximum / 1.001)
    'fitted_at_search_boundary' else 'fitted'
  out
}

# ET-effective storage fitted to ORIGINAL full-canopy ET. The isolated proxy
# uses FAPAR=0 only to reuse the stable bucket integration/calibration machinery.
# Original FAPAR, GPP, transpiration and near-surface diagnostics are untouched.
fit_et_bucket <- function(x, initial = 100, minimum = 1, maximum = 2000, grid_size = 25) {
  required <- c('date', 'precip', 'period_days', 'dl', 'fwet_mean', 'PT_mean',
                'fSM_mean', 'PredLEday_RHVPD')
  if (!all(required %in% names(x))) stop('Run the near-surface fit first to preserve the original ET target.')
  proxy <- x[required]
  proxy$FAPAR <- 0
  proxy$PredLEsday_mean <- x$PredLEday_RHVPD
  proxy$PredLEday_mean <- x$PredLEday_RHVPD
  proxy$PredLEcday_mean <- 0
  proxy$PredLEiday_mean <- 0
  fitted <- fit_soil_bucket(proxy, initial, minimum, maximum, grid_size)
  fields <- c(SM_et='SM', SM_et_mean='SM_mean', SM_et_end='SM_end', SMmax_et='SMmax',
    fSM_et_mean='fSM_mean', fSM_et_start='fSM_start', PredLE_ETeffective='PredLEsday_mean',
    ETbucket_period='Esoil_period', ETsurface_period='Esurface_period', ETbucket_overflow='bucket_overflow')
  has_fit <- 'SMmax' %in% names(fitted) && all(is.finite(fitted$SMmax))
  for (name in names(fields)) x[[name]] <- if (has_fit) fitted[[fields[[name]]]] else NA_real_
  metadata <- c(SM_et_fit_status='SM_fit_status', SM_et_fit_RMSE='SM_fit_RMSE',
    SM_et_initial_guess='SM_initial_guess', SM_et_search_min='SM_search_min',
    SM_et_search_max='SM_search_max', SM_et_initialization='SM_initialization')
  for (name in names(metadata)) x[[name]] <- fitted[[metadata[[name]]]]
  if (all(fitted$SM_fit_status == 'unconstrained_full_bucket')) {
    x$fSM_et_mean <- 1
    x$fSM_et_start <- 1
    x$PredLE_ETeffective <- fitted$PredLEsday_mean
  }
  x$PredLE_ETreference <- x$PredLEday_RHVPD
  x$SM_et_integration <- if (has_fit) fitted$SM_integration else NA_character_
  x$SM_et_units <- 'mm effective ET storage'
  x$ETbucket_period_units <- 'mm/period'
  x
}

# Retired transpiration-only bucket: see archive/transpiration_bucket_2026-09-18/README.md.
# Absolute AWC from the user-supplied Saxton-model regression. Sand is %mass.
# 0-30 cm texture is assumed representative of the effective profile.
# Supply a sand_0_30cm_pct input column or set this site value; never infer missing texture.
site_sand_0_30cm_pct <- NA_real_
add_effective_depths <- function(x, sand_percent = NA_real_) {
  sand <- if ('sand_0_30cm_pct' %in% names(x)) x$sand_0_30cm_pct else rep(sand_percent, nrow(x))
  sand[!is.finite(sand) | sand < 0 | sand > 100] <- NA_real_
  x$sand_0_30cm_pct <- sand
  x$AWC_pct_vol <- 18.57 - 0.14 * sand
  x$AWC_fraction <- x$AWC_pct_vol / 100
  fields <- c(effective_soil_evaporation_depth_cm='SMmax',
    effective_root_depth_et_cm='SMmax_et')
  for (field in names(fields)) {
    capacity <- x[[fields[[field]]]]
    x[[field]] <- ifelse(is.finite(capacity) & capacity > 0, capacity / x$AWC_fraction / 10, NA_real_)
  }
  x
}

plot_soil_storage_diagnostics <- function(x) {
  old <- par(mfrow=c(2,2), mar=c(4,4,5,1))
  on.exit(par(old))
  panel <- function(field, title, ylab, cap=NULL, reference=NULL) {
    values <- if (field %in% names(x)) x[[field]] else rep(NA_real_,nrow(x))
    if (!any(is.finite(values))) { plot.new(); title(main=title); text(0.5,0.5,'Fit unavailable'); return(invisible(NULL)) }
    upper <- if (!is.null(cap)) max(x[[cap]],na.rm=TRUE) else 1
    plot(x$date,values,type='l',xlab='Date',ylab=ylab,main='',ylim=c(0,upper))
    title(main=title,line=3.5)
    if (!is.null(cap)) {
      lines(x$date,x[[cap]],lty=2,col='grey50')
      field <- switch(cap, SMmax='effective_soil_evaporation_depth_cm', SMmax_et='effective_root_depth_et_cm')
      depth <- x[[field]]
      label <- if (cap=='SMmax') 'Effective soil evaporation depth' else 'Effective root depth'
      value <- if (any(is.finite(depth))) sprintf('%.2f m (%.2f ft)',mean(depth,na.rm=TRUE)/100,mean(depth,na.rm=TRUE)/30.48) else 'unavailable'
      mtext(paste0(label,': ',value),side=3,line=1.8,cex=0.75)
      rmse <- x[[if (cap=='SMmax') 'SM_fit_RMSE' else 'SM_et_fit_RMSE']][1]
      flux <- if (cap=='SMmax') 'Soil evaporation' else 'ET'
      text <- if (is.finite(rmse)) sprintf('%.2f W/m^2',rmse) else 'unavailable'
      mtext(paste0(flux,' RMSE (bucket vs ACCLIM): ',text),side=3,line=0.3,cex=0.75)
    }
    if (!is.null(reference)) {
      lines(x$date,x[[reference]],col='tomato')
      legend('topright',c('Bucket','RH/VPD'),col=c('black','tomato'),lty=1,bty='n',cex=0.7)
    }
  }
  panel('SM_mean','Near-surface soil moisture','mm',cap='SMmax')
  panel('fSM_mean','Near-surface moisture constraint','Fraction',reference='fSM_RHVPD')
  panel('SM_et_mean','ET-constrained soil moisture','mm',cap='SMmax_et')
  panel('fSM_et_mean','ET-constrained moisture constraint','Fraction')
}

# Fit after the baseline time series is complete; preserves *_RHVPD diagnostics.
# Capacity search begins at 100 mm, bounded to 1-2000 mm; inspect status/RMSE.
data <- fit_soil_bucket(data)
data <- fit_et_bucket(data)
data <- add_effective_depths(data, site_sand_0_30cm_pct)
print(unique(data[c("AWC_pct_vol", "effective_soil_evaporation_depth_cm", "effective_root_depth_et_cm")]))
print(unique(data[c('SM_fit_status', 'SM_fit_RMSE', 'SM_et_fit_status', 'SM_et_fit_RMSE')]))
plot_soil_storage_diagnostics(data)

```
